app_fee.value: Non-refundable $35 application fee is required for all graduate and Slate/CAS applications.
app_fee.quote: NOTE: All Slate and CAS applications require an additional TSU fee of $35.00/USD. | The $35.00 non-refundable application fee

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver policy for international graduate applicants is stated on the Graduate Catalog admissions or general information pages.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see individual program records (required for Food, Agricultural and Environmental Sciences; Civil & Architectural Engineering's ENCS Ph.D. admissions page states no GRE is required; not specified for Biological Sciences or ENCS Computational Sciences).

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL score of 71 (Internet-based Test) or 525 (Paper Test) for international graduate applicants.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 525 (Paper Test) or 71 (Internet-based Test) on the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL),

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS overall band score of 6.0 (or Duolingo 95, ELS Level 112, or TSU IEC Level 8) for international graduate applicants.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum score of 6.0 on the International English Language Testing System (IELTS),

english_waiver.value: No waiver is stated for an English-medium degree from India; exemption requires completing a bachelor's degree or at least 9 graduate credit hours (minimum 3.0 GPA) at a U.S. institution, or submitting U.S. institutional documentation reviewed by TSU's Intensive English Center.
english_waiver.quote: or students who have completed their undergraduate degree or a minimum of 9 credit hours of graduate courses with a minimum 3.0 GPA at a college or university within the U.S. may submit an official transcript to demonstrate English proficiency,

also.quote: evidence of English language proficiency (transcripts, certificates, etc.) from an accredited U.S. institution equivalent to the required IELTS or TOEFL scores (NOTE: submitted documentation will be reviewed and evaluated by TSU’s Intensive English Center),

notes: Public R2 land-grant HBCU in Nashville, Tennessee. General international priority deadlines are April 1 (abroad) and June 1 (in the U.S.) for Fall; Biological Sciences lists a Fall-only August 1 - November 15 window in the admissions policy table alongside a rolling/July 1 cutoff on its program page.
